name: count
description: A number changing in place (ADR 0028). Formatted with Intl.NumberFormat, one span per character, matched to the previous value from the right; only changed characters move, rising --ui-space-xs × --ui-motion-travel on --ui-duration-base (dropping when the value shrank) while an aria-hidden ghost draws the old character with CSS content and fades on --ui-duration-fast. The text is the plain value at every frame — never digit debris for copy, find, screen readers or tests. Tabular figures; the first render is still; Reduced is a per-digit cross-fade.
